integrity: Symbolic cyclic-run proof and independently constructed exact 32-state transfer determinant; finite exhaustive tests are consistency checks, not a replacement for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Periodic points of the full two-sided good-word shift only; no claim about all aperiodic points, general finite linear word counts, or unindexed prior formulations.
title: Exact periodic-orbit census for antisquare-good binary sequences
